description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Data utilities] Selects values from a JSON document with a JSONPath query (RFC 9535: names, indexes, slices, wildcards, .. descendants, filters with comparisons, && || ! and length/count/value) or a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901). Returns every match with its normalized path and pointer. Input: json and query (POST for large documents), optional max_results. Limits: 1 MB JSON, 1,000-character query; match() and search() are not offered. Offline.

json.description: JSON text, up to 1 MB (a JSON value is also accepted in a POST body or MCP arguments)

max_results.description: Values returned, 1-1000 (default 100); match_count is always the full count

query.description: JSONPath starting with $ (RFC 9535, e.g. $.items[?@.price < 10].name) or JSON Pointer starting with / (RFC 6901, e.g. /items/0/name)

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

name: json_query

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: JSON query: JSONPath (RFC 9535) or JSON Pointer ($0.002/call)
